## bijection_verdict
**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION finding for this task's policies or the retired surface. First revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts; the KB carries them faithfully):
1. `loyalty_ext_birthday_make_good` declares as superseded two goodwill base clauses (documentation; reference/once per claim) and the general "each bonus type posts at most once per bonus reference" clause; the goodwill extended rule restates reference/once-per-claim in force, but welcome/review/referral bonuses are left with no in-force dedup clause — an override broader than the make-good it serves.
2. `loyalty_ext_missing_points_adjustment` retires the base missing-points computation clause, while its own scope covers only reservation fulfilment orders ("any other order … is credited under the missing-points rule as it stands"); non-fulfilment missing-points adjustments are left without an in-force computation.
3. `tier_qualification` retained clause "Reaching the threshold of the tier already held extends tier_valid_through the same way" refers back to a retired clause.
